description.narrative: The Initiation Plan is designed to preserve and strengthen a functioning ecosystem of civil society coordination platforms, service delivery mechanisms and social cohesion processes in conflict-affected set-up in Georgia that have demonstrated tangible results. As previously established, this ecosystem is both interdependent and fragile, requiring strategic investment to prevent systemic erosion.. At the same time, the Plan will create the conditions for future programming by maintaining strategic partnerships, generating evidence and lessons learned, identifying emerging needs and opportunities, and preparing the operational, technical, and coordination foundations necessary for the design and launch of the full-fledged project. In doing so, the Plan will help safeguard existing achievements while ensuring that the ecosystem remains capable of scaling and adapting to future development and peacebuilding priorities.

condition.narrative: The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
